hypothesis: A generic source-only read-before-final instruction delivered through the compact system request improves task-3 evidence follow-through without sacrificing task-2 precision or token advantage.
mechanism: Overlay exactly the frozen compact representation module. Append the generic instruction to COMPACT_SYSTEM, which is the system text actually sent to the provider. No benchmark-labeled paths, source bytes, gold data, or scorer changes.
sequence_rule: Run task 3 first. If it fails its fixed quality or token screen, stop without task 2; no joint claim. Only if task 3 passes, run task 2. No replacement or silent retry.
screen_rule: Task 3 must meet or exceed DSH Span-F1 0.5125361243 and File-F1 0.8 using at most 261037 tokens. If it passes, task 2 must retain perfect Span/File-F1 using at most 461176 tokens. Every dispatched call must have known usage and each native export must be valid.
gold_boundary: Generation mounts source-only task and pinned repository data, not gold or reference patches. Native scoring follows sealed generation.
claim_ceiling: Two exposed tasks under a configured 1M window; no full-cohort or occupied-deep-window generalization.
open_questions: Will verified prompt exposure cause an early confirmed test read?
Can task 3 recover quality within the token budget?
Will task 2 precision hold if task 3 passes?
